name: hey the world is ending anyone up?
source:
This is a visual novel anthology game that follows five characters as they deal with the theoretical end of the world.

[From [url=https://through-the-window.itch.io/hey-the-world-is-ending-anyone-up]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一款视觉小说选集游戏，讲述了五个角色处理理论上的世界末日的故事。

[来自[url=https://through-the-window.itch.io/hey-the-world-is-ending-anyone-up]itch.io[/url]]
